g.title: SN1 solvolysis event 1
g.desc: (CH₃)₃CBr → (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻ C–Br pair → Br; tertiary carbocation is the stated limiting teaching model.

g.text: C–Br pair → Br; tertiary carbocation is the stated limiting teaching model.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: SN1 solvolysis event 2
g.desc: (CH₃)₃C⁺ + H₂O → (CH₃)₃COH₂⁺ Water O lone pair → tertiary C; oxygen becomes oxonium (+1).

g.text: Water O lone pair → tertiary C; oxygen becomes oxonium (+1).
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: SN1 solvolysis event 3
g.desc: (CH₃)₃COH₂⁺ + H₂O → (CH₃)₃COH + H₃O⁺ Second water O → oxonium H; alcohol O–H pair → alcohol O.

g.text: Second water O → oxonium H; alcohol O–H pair → alcohol O.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
